listing.name: Battlezone: Rise of the Black Dogs (BZRecomp)
listing.summary: A Battlezone: Rise of the Black Dogs N64 modernization beta, separate from arcade Battlezone and its existing source ports. Windows/Linux N64Recomp/RT64 packages are documented; complete-game, multiplayer, exact OS minimums and CPU coverage are unconfirmed. Use your own supported USA N64 ROM. Exact accepted revision/hashes and BIOS/firmware requirements are unconfirmed. You and the project manage setup and updates; Portcove has not qualified a release package or confirmed gameplay.
